latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video Editor App Free.
- Instantly edits and exports raw video clips to 1080p MP4s with simple text instructions—no desktop software needed.
- Automatic cloud session and token setup on first use; 100 free credits included for 7 days.
- Supports uploads, timeline editing, text overlays, transitions, and rapid cloud-based rendering (1–2 minutes per job).
- User-friendly commands for export, credits, session state, and upload; robust error handling and platform detection.
- Handles a broad range of video and audio formats; files up to 500MB supported.
